scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @bunbun/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @bunbun/server" "npm run dev --workspace @bunbun/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @bunbun/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @bunbun/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @bunbun/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @bunbun/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bunbun/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @bunbun/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @bunbun/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js README.md
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bunbun/contracts && npm run build --workspace @bunbun/server && npm run build --workspace @bunbun/web
